_doc: harness-sync manifest (committed base — PORTABLE values only). Machine-specific overrides go in harnesses.local.json (gitignored; template: harnesses.local.json.example). harness-sync.sh deep-merges local over this base. Env vars beat both where noted.

claude._doc: The .claude/ layer is rendered by deploy.sh (skills+agents symlinks); harness-sync invokes it for app targets and mirrors FROM it for the other harnesses.

codex._doc: Skills via the vendor-neutral .agents/skills path (also read by Pi). Agent TOMLs are GENERATED, not symlinked — Codex does not follow symlinked agent TOMLs (openai/codex#15345). Never touch config.toml [hooks.state] trusted_hash entries.

droid._doc: No FACTORY_HOME env override exists — ~/.factory is wired via symlinks into the tracked tools/droid/ dir (setup.sh pattern). App-level .factory/ dirs are projected directly.

pi._doc: Pi reads .agents/skills up the cwd tree (covered by the codex mirror) + <home>/skills globally. No declarative agents/hooks/MCP surfaces — those are skipped with a warning, never silently.
